extraction_scope: Worker-6 final bounded mechanism ontology from local XML/PDF/supplement packet. Mechanism claims are restricted to armadillidin H where the paper actually ran downstream assays; armadillidin Q is not assigned mechanism evidence beyond activity equivalence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Armadillidin H is directly bactericidal against representative Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria in CFU/time-kill assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: armadillidin H; B. megaterium F04 and P. syringae DC3000

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=20:Bactericidal Activity of Armadillidin H and Kill; xml:fig=2:FIGURE 2; xml:fig=3:FIGURE 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: Bactericidal/time-kill experiments were performed for armadillidin H, not armadillidin Q.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Armadillidin H damages bacterial cell envelopes and permeabilizes bacterial membranes in microscopy and dye-uptake assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: armadillidin H; B. megaterium F04 and P. syringae DC3000
direct_assay_types: propidium iodide membrane-permeabilization assay with CFU correlation

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=21:Morphological Changes Induced by Armadillidin H ; xml:sec=22:Armadillidin H Induced Membrane Permeabilization; xml:fig=4:FIGURE 4; xml:fig=5:FIGURE 5; xml:fig=7:FIGURE 7

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports membrane-active/permeabilizing action but does not resolve a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Armadillidin H disrupts A. brassicicola hyphae/cell-wall morphology and permeabilizes fungal cells in microscopy and SYTOX/uptake evidence.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=21:Morphological Changes Induced by Armadillidin H ; xml:sec=22:Armadillidin H Induced Membrane Permeabilization; xml:fig=6:FIGURE 6; xml:fig=8:FIGURE 8

mechanism_claims.limitations: Fungal mechanism evidence is limited to the tested A. brassicicola model.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD/NMR analyses did not identify a stable secondary structure for armadillidin H, including under the membrane-mimicking conditions tested.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This structural finding bounds mechanism interpretation; it is not by itself an antimicrobial mechanism.
